seo.aeoSummary: Object & watermark remover (Inpainting) processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using lama-fp16-pruned (Tier M). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Object & watermark remover (Inpainting) upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Object & watermark remover (Inpainting) executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using lama-fp16-pruned. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Object & watermark remover (Inpainting)?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/magic_eraser.json or open /tools/magic-eraser?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
